final.basis: The collision damage to the insured's own car is covered under the collision coverage clause, which pays for direct and accidental loss caused by collision, less the deductible. The deductible has already been applied to the net payable amount. The claim involves bodily injury, which must be handled by an injury specialist, but this does not affect the coverage of the collision damage itself. The presence of material inconsistencies requires referral to the special investigations unit before payment, but this is a procedural step and not an exclusion.
